title: Deliver bounded CAP-INV-008 Search and Hunt Provenance projections under Shared Trace ownership
goal: Stage native Search/Hunt provenance under Investigate semantics while reusing existing Shared Search Job, Trace and Event owner, starting with an authorized read-only local run projection; no Trace persistence or OPEN-015 decision.
invariants: Investigate defines provenance semantics; Search Job/Telemetry Event and eventual Trace/Activity Stream remain Shared owned.
An epic is a container, not a completed runtime, acceptance or full CAP-INV-008 deliverable.
Do not persist Trace or change OPEN-015; metadata missing from Shared SearchJob must be explicitly unavailable.
security_properties: Never show foreign Case or stale SearchJob run metadata, raw previews, credentials or hidden source identifiers.
Only data from an already completed, server-authorized Search Job can appear in transient provenance.

migration.rationale: Read-only UI stage with no persistent state or schema.

rollback.strategy: Revert bounded read-only provenance UI stage without changing Event Search backend.
verification: Existing authenticated Search Job and source ACL remain unchanged.

inputs: Canonical CAP-INV-008 full fiche and Shared-owned first-party SearchJob.
Existing transient Class-0 Search Job workspace, verified runtime dependencies and OPEN-015 limitations.
outputs: E10-INV-008A-PROVENANCE bounded lot with independent exact-sha browser proof.
Later Shared-owned Trace persistence and audit hook work only under accepted product authority.
acceptance_tests: Every executed lot uses validated manifest and exact-head CI with unchanged security floor.
Epic remains DECOMPOSED until complete canonical CAP-INV-008 obligations, approvals and acceptance.
definition_of_ready: Existing first-party completed Search Job and source owner runtime exist.
definition_of_done: All product capability acceptance conditions and retention/redaction policies are resolved under canonical owners.
